visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern kitchen setting. A young man with black hair and earrings is seated at a white table, looking back over his shoulder towards the camera. He is in a domestic environment with a purple backsplash and various kitchen items visible in the background. A tortoiseshell cat is perched nearby, initially looking away from him. (2) As the man addresses the cat, the scene cuts to the cat sitting on a black metal shelf. The cat looks towards the camera with a squinted, somewhat annoyed expression. Yellow variety-show style text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen, mimicking the cat's rejection of the man's request. (3) The man is shown again, holding a black mobile phone or remote. He gestures towards the cat, who is now seen rolling playfully or dismissively on the white tiled floor near a litter box. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a well-lit apartment. (4) A comedic sequence follows where the man is seen crawling on his hands and knees on a wooden hallway floor, moving away from the camera towards a doorway. This transition leads into a more affectionate scene where he is hugging the cat close to his chest, with the cat maintaining its stoic, unamused facial expression. (5) The man sits on a large purple beanbag chair, holding his smartphone horizontally as if playing a game. He pets the tortoiseshell cat, which is resting beside him. The scene transitions into a direct screen capture of the mobile game Tree of Savior M, showing various character classes and vibrant fantasy environments with high-saturation colors and detailed graphics. (6) The final segment features promotional graphics and animated overlays. It shows a Shiba Inu dog and a cat wearing sunglasses against a light background. Further gameplay footage highlights characters walking through a forest with their pet companions, ending with a large game title logo and a call-to-download slogan in bold text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with a gentle, finger-picked acoustic guitar melody with a moderate tempo. A male voice with a clear, conversational tone speaks in Mandarin, sounding friendly yet persuasive. There is a very faint background hum typical of an indoor room tone, creating a natural home atmosphere. (2) A sharp, distinct meow from a cat interrupts the speech, followed immediately by a bright, metallic ding sound effect that coincides with a variety-show text overlay. The man's voice slightly rises in pitch as he continues to talk to the cat in a playful, teasing manner. (3) As the man begins to crawl, the background music swells slightly and transitions into a rhythmic acoustic pop style with a soft percussion beat. A whoosh sound effect accompanies a fast edit. The man's vocal arousal remains neutral to positive, maintaining a lighthearted comedic vibe. (4) The audio undergoes a significant structural shift as the advertisement begins. The acoustic music is replaced by an epic, orchestral fantasy track characteristic of RPG games, featuring strings and brass. The man's voice adopts a more professional, energetic narrative style, with clear articulation and higher loudness to emphasize game features. (5) Throughout the gameplay montage, various digital UI sound effects like clicks and chimes are heard, synchronized with on-screen menu changes. The music remains continuous and high-energy. The final phase concludes with a celebratory orchestral flourish and a final spoken slogan, with the music fading out sharply at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous lifestyle hook featuring the creator's stubborn cat to establish a relatable and warm tone. This interaction serves as a thematic bridge to promote the mobile game Tree of Savior M, specifically highlighting its pet mount system and character class variety. The intent is to convert the viewer's emotional engagement with the creator into interest for the game through a formal feature showcase and a direct download call-to-action.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of game title logo, extended gameplay footage, professional narration of game features, and a clear call to download at the end.
